body:
I experienced seizures one day after my 'come down' for about a week (6-7 days) it was quite scary because I didn't really understand what was happening. It could have been a dosage issue or a impurity issue or even just a me issue however, when I went to the doctor who happened to be a friend who was also getting high with us at the time she said it was most likely due to the impurities used to cut the Molly.
She did give me medication however I did NOT take them and  the seizures went away on their own (THANK GOD).  I feel like this is a pretty big issue and people should be informed.
[Reported Dose: '375-400mg']
